C1694.title: Home Camera Cloud Storage Video Leak Leads to Privacy Being Livestreamed
C1694.summary: In March 2025, police warned about serious privacy risks with home cameras. Some cameras have vulnerabilities allowing hackers to crack default passwords, spy on private scenes, and profit from livestreaming.
